| DET + ADJ + N + N + N | a careful school bus driver | 小心判斷形容詞指向。 |
| DET + N + N + N + N | the school bus safety rules | 長串要清楚分組。 |
| DET + ADJ + N + RELATIVE | the young boy who waved | 前後都有修飾。 |
| DET + N + PP | the book on the desk | 介詞短語後置。 |
| DET + N + ‐ing | the man waiting outside | ‐ing 描述名詞。 |
| DET + N + PAST PARTICIPLE | the letters sent yesterday | 常有被動意思。 |
| DET + N + to-INFINITIVE | a letter to write | 常說要做的事。 |
| DET + N + that-CONTENT | the fact that she won | that 說內容,不是關係字。 |


## VIII.2 結構與句中工作要分開

| 結構 | 可做的工作例子 | 例句 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 名詞短語 | 主語 | The old house is empty. |
| 名詞短語 | 受詞 | I bought a red bag. |
| 名詞短語 | be 後補語 | Mia is a student. |
| 名詞短語 | 介詞後補充 | near the bridge |
| 名詞短語 | 時間補充 | We met last Friday. |
| that 內容子句 | 主語 | That she won surprised us. |
| that 內容子句 | 動詞後內容 | I know that she won. |
| wh- 間接問題 | 動詞後內容 | I wonder where she went. |
| 融合關係子句 | 主語/受詞 | What she said mattered. |
| ‐ing 子句 | 主語/受詞 | Reading books is useful. |
| to 不定詞子句 | 主語/補語 | To travel alone is exciting. |
| 引述的話語 | 被談論的內容 | “I agree” was her reply. |


## VIII.3 主要 ‐ing 和 to 子句比較

| 要表達甚麼 | 常見形式 | 例子 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 一項活動 | ‐ing | Swimming is fun. |
| 一項活動或目標 | to + 動詞 | To save money takes effort. |
| 說明做事者 | for + 人 + to | For Mia to leave would be sad. |
| 說明未解決問題 | wh + to | I don't know what to say. |
| 說是否做事 | whether to | We must decide whether to stay. |
| 在介詞後說動作 | preposition + ‐ing | without saying goodbye |
| 被動 | being + 過去分詞 | Being chosen surprised her. |
| 完成式 | having + 過去分詞 | Having finished early helped. |


## VIII.4 量、數和動詞

| 主語 | 常見動詞 | 為甚麼 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| The book | is | 一本。 |
| The books | are | 多本。 |
| Every book | is | every + 單數名詞。 |
| The list of books | is | 中心是 list。 |
| A number of books | are | 一些書。 |
| The number of books | is | 書本數量。 |
| A group of visitors | is / are | 整組/成員角度,英式用法可變。 |
| The elderly | are | 通常指一群人。 |
| Swimming every day | is | 一項活動。 |
| Swimming and running | are | 兩項活動並列時常用複數。 |


## VIII.5 判斷名詞後的句子是甚麼

| 英文 | 後接句子的工作 | 怎樣看 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| the news that she resigned | 消息內容 | she resigned 已是一件完整的事。 |
| the news that she reported | 關係子句 | reported 後欠受詞。 |
| the boy who waved | 關係子句 | who 代表男孩作主語。 |
| the bag I bought | 零關係字 | bought 的受詞由 bag 承接。 |
| the man waiting outside | ‐ing 描述 | 說明男子的行動。 |
| the report sent yesterday | 過去分詞描述 | 報告接受寄出的動作。 |
| a report to write | 不定詞描述 | 說明要寫的報告。 |


## VIII.6 用字類找不到答案時

先看真正的句子位置。 再問哪組字是名詞短語、哪組字是子句、哪個名詞決定單複數、哪個介詞或動詞要求後面的接法。如果兩句都通順,還要比較它們是否保留相同的時間、數量和意思。

# PART IX — Diagnostic Tests & Challenging Examples｜練習與思考

這些練習沒有答案。選擇題只有一個最符合題目指定意思的選項;需要寫句子或解釋的題目,可以有多種合理答案,只要符合指示、文法自然,並保留意思。中文只幫助理解;作答時先看英文題目。

選擇最合適的英文句子｜Choose the best sentence

Q001

Choose the only sentence that naturally means someone bought one chair in standard English.

【哪一句在一般標準英文中正確?請選一個單數可數名詞的寫法。】

A. She bought chair.

B. She bought a chair.

C. She bought an chair.

Q002

In which sentence is the whole phrase “the red bag” the grammatical subject?

【哪一句用完整的 the red bag 作主語?】

A. The red bag fell.

B. Mia carried the red bag.

C. We waited beside the red bag.

Q003

Which sentence has a common-noun phrase referring to a school as its main subject?

【哪一句把「那所學校」表達為專有名稱以外的普通名詞短語?】

A. Hong Kong is busy.

B. Mia is here.

C. The new school is open.

Q004

Which sentence correctly says that three notebooks arrived today?

【哪一句正確表達「三本筆記簿今天到達」?】

A. Three notebook arrived today.

B. Three notebooks arrived today.

C. Three notebooks arrives today.

Q005

Which sentence correctly says that a form requires some information?

【哪一句自然地使用不可數的 information?】

A. The form requires some information.

B. The form requires an information.

C. The form requires informations.

Q006

Which sentence correctly refers to several boxes made for shoes?

【哪一句表示「這些鞋盒」?】

A. These shoes boxes are heavy.

B. These shoe box are heavy.

C. These shoe boxes are heavy.

Q007

Which sentence refers to a drink consisting of one cup of coffee, not a cup used for coffee?

【哪一句是在說「一杯咖啡」,而不是「咖啡杯」?】

A. She ordered a coffee cup.

B. She ordered a cup of coffee.

C. She ordered a coffee table.

Q008

Which option naturally names a person who drives a school bus?

【哪一句表達「校巴司機」?】

A. The school bus driver arrived.

B. The school driver bus arrived.

C. The bus school driver arrived.

Q009

Which sentence refers to a new driver of a school bus?

【哪一句表達「一位新校巴司機」?】

A. A school new bus driver arrived.

B. A bus driver school new arrived.

C. A new school bus driver arrived.

Q010

Which sentence correctly uses the plural of “mother-in-law”?

【哪一句用正確複數說「兩位岳母或婆婆」?】

A. Two mother-in-laws arrived.

B. Two mothers-in-law arrived.

C. Two mother-in-law arrived.

Q011

Which sentence correctly refers to a room connected with several children?

【哪一句正確表達「那些孩子的房間」?】

A. The children's room is bright.

B. The childrens room is bright.

C. The childrens' room is bright.

Q012

Which sentence correctly uses a possessive expression for an office shared by several teachers?

【哪一句正確表達「那位老師們的辦公室」中的複數所屬?】

A. The teacher's office is upstairs.

B. The teachers office is upstairs.

C. The teachers' office is upstairs.

Q013

Which sentence naturally says that one of my colleagues found the keys?

【哪一句表示「我的其中一位同事找到了鎖匙」?】

A. A colleague of my found the keys.

B. A colleague of mine found the keys.

C. A colleague of me found the keys.

Q014

Which sentence most clearly identifies the photo on the wall as mine?

【哪一句用名詞後的介詞短語指出是哪張相片?】

A. The photo on the wall is mine.

B. The photo is mine on the wall.

C. On the wall my photo.

Q015

Which sentence uses a relative clause to identify the girl who lives next door?

【哪一句用關係子句介紹女孩?】

A. The girl lives next door who is kind.

B. The girl who lives next door is kind.

C. The girl who next door lives is kind.

Q016

Which sentence contains a standard zero relative clause with its subject still expressed?

【哪一句用零關係字而仍保留主語?】

C. The bag I bought yesterday is blue.

Q017

Which sentence uses an -ing clause after “man” to identify the person waiting at the door?

【哪一句用 -ing 子句描述哪位男子?】

Q018

Which sentence refers to tickets that were printed this morning?

【哪一句說「今早印好的門票」?】

Q019

【哪一句表示「消息的內容是她辭職」?】

Q020

【哪一句是普通標準英文的間接問題?】

【哪一句表示「你寫的內容很有道理」?】

【哪一句正確說「誰提早到,誰就有座位」?】

Q026

【哪一句用 -ing 子句作主語?】

Q027

Which sentence uses the normal verb-complement pattern after “enjoy”?

【哪一句是 enjoy 後的自然接法?】

Q028

Which sentence naturally says that Ben entered without knocking?

【哪一句正確說「Ben 沒有敲門就進來」?】

Q029

Which sentence naturally expresses looking forward to meeting new students?

【哪一句正確說「我們期待見到新同學」?】

# PART X — Final Coverage Check｜學完後自己檢查

你可以不用背規則編號,只要能獨立完成以下工作:

**找中心:**在 a careful school bus driver 中指出真正的名詞中心。

**找整組:**在長句裏圈出完整的名詞短語,而不只圈一個名詞。

**看修飾:**分清名詞前的形容詞、名詞修飾語與名詞後面的介詞短語。

**看數量:**能選 a、an、the、零冠詞、單複數和動詞形式。

**讀長組合:**能分清 N + N + N 等較長組合,也知道何時應改寫得更清楚。

**看所屬:**能使用 's、複數所有格、of 短語及 a friend of mine。

**看子句:**能說明 the news that she resigned 和 the news that she reported 有甚麼不同。

**看問題:**能分辨 I know what she said 和 I wonder what she said 的意思。

**看活動:**能分辨 Reading books、the reading of books、To read books 的內部接法。

**看不同位置:**知道名詞短語可以做主語、受詞、補語或時間補充。

**看特殊形式:**明白代名詞、數字、the elderly 和引述句子也能被當作談論對象。

**看語境:**如果一個句子可以有兩種合理解讀,會先說明兩種意思,再決定如何改寫。

最後一個問題:「這一組字的中心是甚麼?它在句子裏做甚麼?換一種寫法後,原本的意思有沒有改變?」先問這三個問題,再選文法形式,通常比只記住詞類名稱更有用。
